findings.evidence: The unique largest positive polynomial exponent identifies the correct answer on both saved quotient questions (6 and 7). This fails on saved MA q-49059, whose largest exponent option is wrong.
findings.scope: A defect of this two-question published quotient pool, not a claim of a universal sampler shortcut.

findings.evidence: sqrt(x)(x+3) versus sqrt(x)(-x+3), same non-x coefficient and same selected bank role 0; only the sign of the x term changes.
Complete easy q-113787 exists, but generator supports only moderate. Author explicitly excluded the entire easy band because the one complete radio example does not cover other easy families.
findings.assessment: An unnecessarily narrow coverage decision; not a mathematical error or evidence that moderate radical/quotient questions are out of scope.

findings.evidence: f(x)/x^d always simplifies to a+b/x^2; numerator/denominator degree is deliberately coupled and mathematically irrelevant. Function wrapper comes from restoring missing context in MA multipart sources.
findings.assessment: Valid source-grounded exercise with narrow reasoning variation and avoidable function indirection; not a prerequisite violation.
